cd /testbed && cat > tests/admin_views/test_repro_custom_site.py <<'EOF'
from django.contrib.admin import AdminSite, ModelAdmin
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.test import TestCase, override_settings
from django.urls import path, reverse

from .models import Child, Parent

custom_site = AdminSite(name='custom-admin')


class ChildAdmin(ModelAdmin):
    readonly_fields = ('parent',)


custom_site.register(Parent, ModelAdmin)
custom_site.register(Child, ChildAdmin)

urlpatterns = [path('custom-admin/', custom_site.urls)]


@override_settings(ROOT_URLCONF=__name__)
class CustomAdminSiteReadonlyFKTest(TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.superuser = User.objects.create_superuser(
            username='super', email='super@example.com', password='secret',
        )
        cls.parent = Parent.objects.create(name='parent')
        cls.child = Child.objects.create(name='child', parent=cls.parent)

    def test_readonly_fk_link_uses_custom_admin_site(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.superuser)
        url = reverse('custom-admin:admin_views_child_change', args=[self.child.pk])
        response = self.client.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        expected = reverse(
            'custom-admin:admin_views_parent_change', args=[self.parent.pk],
        )
        content = response.content.decode()
        self.assertIn('href="%s"' % expected, content)
        self.assertNotIn('href="/admin/admin_views/parent/', content)
EOF
